description.en:
MATRIX-3 is Matrix Robotics' third-generation humanoid platform. Its design brings together tactile sensing, a humanlike exterior, dexterous hands and coordinated locomotion, with the company emphasizing physical interaction as well as visual perception.

The platform's software direction combines learned behavior with the ability to interpret and adapt to changing tasks. Matrix positions it for movement from specialized industrial applications toward a wider range of everyday environments. Its distinguishing development themes include body-level sensing, hand manipulation and integrated control. These describe the platform's design and intended capabilities; the public launch presentation does not establish that every proposed task is already available as a deployed autonomous service.

specs.label: Hand degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Per hand, including the articulated wrist; manufacturer describes a 27-DoF design.
